headline: Brazilian Real Drops 10.8% in Three Months as Fiscal Concerns Mount
summary: The Brazilian real fell 10.8% over three months, ranking as the worst performer among 13 key emerging market currencies. BTG projected 2027 inflation at 5.9% and GDP growth at 0.6%.
why: The Brazilian real is Latin America's largest currency; its depreciation feeds domestic inflation and influences Banco Central do Brasil interest rate decisions.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Domestic fiscal execution uncertainties and inflation forecasts pressured the real lower.
